plugins.name: okf
plugins.description: Open Knowledge Format — an APM package that distributes the pure OKF format standard and validator.

plugins.name: atlas
plugins.description: Atlas is a distributed Semantic Knowledge Network built with technologies LLMs already know: git and markdown, with a SCHEMA and a CLI that keep agents inside pre-defined, extensible domains.

plugins.name: discuss
plugins.description: Run a discussion as a durable, agent-maintained Atlas graph. Fill the gaps in your thinking with this companion skill that explores the graph for you, finds where they are, and proposes solutions.

plugins.name: think
plugins.description: One install gives nine agent harnesses three ways to think: capture ideas, interrogate assumptions, and challenge claims with sources.

plugins.name: atlas-cartograph
plugins.description: Cartograph is an Atlas knowledge-graph viewer for the GitHub Copilot App.

plugins.name: autogenesis
plugins.description: Autogenesis is an expanded discipline of danielmeppiel/genesis that uses Atlas as long-term memory for the skill, wherever it is used, pairs with skills such as discuss and think and incorporates minor new patterns and disciplines, such as Activation Cards, Modules, or a skill-native SOLID design lens.

plugins.name: atlas-tasks
plugins.description: Distributed Atlas task discipline for agents that already use Atlas: per-Atlas task lists, colocated task bodies, and core Atlas task pages as pointers.

plugins.name: atlas-people
plugins.description: Operator-owned people Atlas skill: query and remember people and typed relationships on a dedicated store, with a supervised one-shot Apple Notes import.
